snippet.title: A Bomb's Way
snippet.description:
A Bomb's Way is available now for the XBox 360 through the 'Indie Games' channel. It's a 2D platformer featuring a new character with a short fuse. In each level you must collect all the clocks before you run out of time and explode. Each clock collected gives you a little bit more fuse to complete the level but there's no time to relax before you'll be looking for the next. Add in some firey beasties, the ability to rotate the level and you've got the ultimate arcade experience.

http://marketplace.xbox.com/en-GB/Product/A-Bombs-Way/66acd000-77fe-1000-9115-d802585501d6

http://www.smudgedcat.com/7.html
